Unmodified geometry from `pzfreo/dw-examples`, commit
`525e3f5cfd11ed55165fe5c290d139548a62f534`,
`steps/text-to-cad/mounting-plate.step` (gzip packaging with mtime 0).

`amywork777/text-to-cad-upstream`, commit
`85d8fdbfb467ebd7e22994fe8bcd86afa6626ed3`,
`models/examples/src/mounting_plate.py`, unchanged.
